desc: Derive and verify the binomial expansion formula: answer = Σ_{j=1..N} Σ_{t=0..K} C(K,t) S_j^t · (−1)^{K−t} · (Σ_{i=0..j−1} S_i^{K−t}), all mod p.
Precompute binomial coefficients C(K,t) for t = 0..K (Pascal's rule or direct formula) modulo 998244353.

Implement a single pass over the array: maintain running prefix sum S and an array pw[m] = Σ of S_i^m over all previous prefix sums (including S₀ = 0); for each new S, compute S^t for t = 0..K and accumulate the answer using the formula, then update pw[m] with S^m.
Handle modular signs carefully: when K−t is odd, subtract the term instead of adding (or add (p − term)).

Write the full Python solution with fast stdin reading (sys.stdin.buffer), int list parsing, and print the answer; sanity-check logic against the given samples mentally or via reasoning (e.g., N=3, K=2 case yields 75).
